t: After months of searching, we just added a cheap(ish) recommendation to our best OLED TV guide
s: July 26, 2022 - The best small OLED TV we've tested thus far ... Smaller TVs always perform differently to their larger counterparts. This is for a variety of reasons, including pixel density, the impact smaller dimensions have on the speakers' ability to move air around and more. Which is why, though we recommend the C5 to people looking for a 55-inch or 65-inch TV, for buyers looking for a small OLED we actually recommend the 48-inch Panasonic Z90B, not the LG.
